products.name: Relay
products.description: Team messaging with file sync across phone, tablet and web.

facts.message: A message from Phone A ("ping") is in #qa-sandbox
facts.read-on-b: Phone B has had #qa-sandbox open since the message arrived
facts.reacted-on-b: Phone B reacted 👍 to the message
facts.edit-typed: The new text is typed but not saved
facts.offline: Phone A is in airplane mode
facts.queued: Messages were sent from phone A while offline
facts.~rejected: An oversized file was just tried
facts.~muted-sent: Dana just sent messages to the muted channel
facts.~reconnected: Phone A just came back online
facts.~downloaded: The photo was just downloaded on the laptop

fresh.say: Relay not installed on Phone A. Relay installed on Phone B, signed out. Dana signed in on her laptop.

signed-in.say: Signed in as QA on Phone A and Phone B, on the channel list. Dana signed in on her laptop.

actions.do: Launch Relay after installing the release build.
Sign in with the QA email and a wrong password.
Sign in with the right password.
Sign in with the QA account.
Go back to the channel list.
Go back to the channel list.
Attach a photo from the gallery.
Attach the file larger than 100 MB.
Go back to the channel list.
Go back to the channel list.
Start typing a message without sending it.
Close Relay completely (swipe it out of recents).

tests.title: Fresh install opens on the welcome screen
tests.expectedResult: No cached account is shown; the sign-in button is enabled.

tests.title: Sign-in rejects a wrong password
tests.expectedResult: An inline error appears under the password field. The field is not cleared.

tests.title: Sign-in succeeds with valid credentials
tests.expectedResult: The channel list loads within 3 seconds and shows the workspace name in the header.

tests.title: Workspace name renders in the header
tests.expectedResult: Full name, not truncated, on a 6" screen.

tests.title: Sending a message shows it optimistically
tests.expectedResult: The message appears in the thread immediately with a pending clock icon.

given.look: Watch the message as it sends.

tests.title: Sent message is confirmed
tests.expectedResult: The clock icon becomes a single check within 2 seconds.

tests.title: Message arrives on a second device
tests.expectedResult: The message appears on the other signed-in device without a manual refresh.

tests.title: Read receipt updates on the sender device
tests.expectedResult: The single check becomes a double check once the recipient opens the thread.

tests.title: Typing indicator appears for the recipient
tests.expectedResult: "Dana is typing…" shows under the thread header and clears after 5 seconds of inactivity.

tests.title: Emoji reaction syncs across devices
tests.expectedResult: The reaction and its count are identical on both devices.

tests.title: Editing a message marks it as edited
tests.expectedResult: The text updates everywhere and an "edited" label appears next to the timestamp.

tests.title: Deleting a message removes it for everyone
tests.expectedResult: The message is replaced by "Message deleted" on every device in the thread.

tests.title: Image attachment uploads with a progress bar
tests.expectedResult: A determinate progress bar runs to 100%, then the thumbnail renders.

tests.title: Attachment opens in the full-screen viewer
tests.expectedResult: Pinch-to-zoom works and the download button is visible.

given.look: Try to zoom, and find the download button.

tests.title: Large file over the limit is rejected
tests.expectedResult: Upload is blocked before it starts, with a message naming the 100 MB limit.

tests.title: Downloaded file keeps its original filename
tests.expectedResult: The saved file matches the uploaded name, including spaces and extension.

given.look: Look at the downloaded file's name.

tests.title: Push notification arrives when the app is closed
tests.expectedResult: A notification with the sender name and message preview appears within 10 seconds.

tests.title: Tapping a notification opens the right thread
tests.expectedResult: The app opens directly to the thread, scrolled to the new message.

tests.title: Muting a channel stops notifications
tests.expectedResult: No banner or sound for new messages in that channel; the badge still increments.

given.look: Watch the phone for a few seconds.

tests.title: Messages sent offline are queued
tests.expectedResult: The message shows a pending state and stays in the thread while offline.

tests.title: Queued messages send on reconnect
tests.expectedResult: All queued messages send in their original order once connectivity returns.

tests.title: Offline banner appears and clears
tests.expectedResult: "You are offline" shows under the header and disappears within 5 seconds of reconnecting.

tests.title: Sign-out clears local message cache
tests.expectedResult: After signing out and back in as another user, no previous messages are visible.

given.look: Look through the channel list and a thread.

tests.title: Dark mode applies to the whole thread view
tests.expectedResult: No light-themed elements remain, including the attachment viewer.

given.look: Look over every part of the thread.

tests.title: Search returns messages from an archived channel
tests.expectedResult: Archived results appear under a separate heading and open read-only.

tests.title: Scheduled messages send at the chosen time
tests.expectedResult: The message leaves the queue within a minute of the scheduled time and shows a sent check.

templates.name: Monthly regression — fresh install
templates.description: The full pass we run on release week, starting from a wiped device.

flows.name: First run and sign-in
flows.precondition: Relay uninstalled from the Pixel. You have valid credentials for the QA workspace.

steps.text: Install the release build on the Pixel.

steps.postState: The app is open on its first screen.

steps.expectedResult: Welcome screen, no cached account, sign-in enabled.

steps.text: Enter the QA email and a deliberately wrong password.

steps.postState: Still on the sign-in screen, with the error showing.

steps.expectedResult: Inline error under the password field; field keeps its text.
Loads under 3s; workspace name in the header, not truncated.

steps.text: Return to a thread and inspect every surface.
steps.expectedResult: No light-themed elements anywhere, viewer included.

flows.name: Messaging across two devices
flows.precondition: Signed in on the Pixel from the previous flow. Have the iPhone nearby but leave it locked for now.

steps.text: Watch the message as it sends.
steps.expectedResult: Appears immediately with a pending clock, then a single check within 2s.

steps.text: Sign in with the same account.
Look for the message you just sent.
steps.expectedResult: "ping 1" is present without pulling to refresh.
The single check has become a double check.
The 👍 you added on the iPhone, with a count of 1.
Text updated with an "edited" label by the timestamp.

steps.text: On the second laptop, signed in as Dana, open #qa-sandbox.
Start typing a message, without sending it.

steps.expectedResult: "Dana is typing…" appears, then clears after ~5s.

steps.text: Check the thread on the iPhone.
steps.expectedResult: "ping 1 edited" is replaced by "Message deleted".

steps.text: Check the thread on the second laptop.
steps.expectedResult: The same "Message deleted" in place of the message.

flows.name: Attachments
flows.precondition: Signed in on the Pixel. Have a photo and a file larger than 100 MB on the device.

steps.text: In #qa-sandbox, attach a photo from the gallery.

steps.expectedResult: Determinate progress bar to 100%, then a thumbnail.

steps.text: Try to zoom and find the download control.
steps.expectedResult: Pinch-to-zoom works; download button visible.
Blocked before upload starts; message names the 100 MB limit.

steps.text: Open the web app on the laptop.

steps.expectedResult: Filename matches the original, spaces and extension intact.

flows.name: Notifications and account switching
flows.precondition: Notifications allowed for Relay on the Pixel. Second laptop signed in as Dana.

steps.text: Close Relay completely on the Pixel (swipe it out of recents).

steps.expectedResult: Notification with sender name and preview within 10s.
Opens #qa-sandbox scrolled to the new message.

steps.text: Open the channel menu and mute #qa-sandbox.
As Dana, send two more messages.

steps.expectedResult: No banner or sound; the channel badge still increments.

steps.text: Look through the channel list and threads.
steps.expectedResult: None of the previous account's messages are visible.

templates.name: Offline and reconnect
templates.description: Run on a device we can put into airplane mode without losing the session.

flows.name: Queue and drain
flows.precondition: Signed in on the Pixel with #qa-sandbox open. Wi-Fi and mobile data both available.

steps.expectedResult: "You are offline" banner is visible.
All three stay in the thread with a pending state.
All three send in order; banner clears within 5s.

templates.name: SMS bridge (legacy)
templates.description: Kept for the bridge we no longer ship. Never scheduled — retained for coverage history.

flows.name: Bridge pairing
flows.precondition: A SIM-enabled handset paired to the workspace.

steps.text: Open the archived channel from search.
steps.expectedResult: Archived results grouped separately and read-only.

T-03.note: Took about 5s on the first load after install. Fine on every load after that.

T-24.note: The settings screen was redesigned in 4.2 — there is no Appearance section any more. This test needs rewriting.

T-10.note: Reaction count showed 2 on the iPhone and 1 on the Pixel. Pull-to-refresh corrected it.

products.name: Beacon Console
products.description: Admin console for provisioning Relay workspaces.

tests.title: Creating a workspace provisions it within a minute
tests.expectedResult: The workspace appears in the list with status Active and a generated ID.

tests.title: Provisioning failure surfaces the reason
tests.expectedResult: An inline banner names the failing step; the workspace is left in Failed, not Active.

tests.title: Suspending a workspace blocks new sign-ins
tests.expectedResult: Existing sessions continue; a new sign-in is refused with a suspension notice.

tests.title: Seat count reflects invited members
tests.expectedResult: The seat counter increments on invite acceptance, not on invite send.

tests.title: Audit log records who provisioned a workspace
tests.expectedResult: The entry names the admin, the workspace and the timestamp, and cannot be edited.

tests.title: Exporting the workspace list produces a CSV
tests.expectedResult: Every visible column is present and the file opens without a warning.

templates.name: Admin console pass
templates.description: Run against a staging tenant with provisioning enabled.

flows.name: Provisioning a workspace end to end
flows.precondition: Signed in to the staging console as an admin. No workspace named 'qa-scratch' exists.

steps.expectedResult: Appears as Active with a generated ID inside a minute.

steps.text: Read the seat counter on the console.
steps.expectedResult: Incremented by one — the accepted invite only.

steps.text: Try to sign in as the invited member.
steps.expectedResult: Refused with a suspension notice; the existing session keeps working.
Names the admin, the workspace and the time. Not editable.
